meta.fps_note: source is 30 fps: sampling at 60 fps repeats frames - each real frame appears ~2.0x. Repeats are marked '=' on the sheets and are NOT new information.

banned_rule.why: purple / violet / blue neon / cyan glow = the generic 'AI' look Sujon banned (Nov 3, 2026: 'Perpel colour aur a sab ai genetic colour use mat kato'). v5.2 widened the range to 175-320 deg so cyan glow and magenta-purple are caught too.

meta.how_to_fill: Open each sheet, look at every frame, fill the empty fields in seconds[] and events[]. Then run: python3 ref_breakdown.py md <this folder>
meta.filled_by: machine facts (60 fps decode: motion, cuts, colours, audio onsets) + Tab's own viewing of 2 fps contact sheets (every 0.5 s). Rows are marked viewed; nothing here claims every 60 fps frame was looked at by eye.

summary: Zero hard cuts: 12 scenes joined by zoom-blur swaps; every scene = one avatar + one hook object + step chip; objects pop 0->110->100% then float; thin ripple ring marks every new fact.
Caption system: 1 line, word-by-word, last words blur out; ONE keyword blue + ONE italic orange word per line.
Palette: cream/peach/pale-blue soft light, blue + green accents (nothing purple/cyan).
make_it_ours: Palette: warm paper + one amber->rose gradient keyword instead of blue keyword
Counter built in EffectCraft with no halo (glow off)
Our own avatar/icon set (no chibi copy), concept label on every business example
Swap transition: card-flip/paper-slide instead of zoom-blur
